name: Previous-day high / low break and retest
idea: Within one session, after a close beyond the previous day's high (or low), wait for the market to come back to that level and hold it; the idea is wrong back through the level.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the previous day's high (or low) the breaking close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: ATR period
params.help: The bars of the average true range that the break distance, the retest zone and the buffer are measured in.

params.label: What counts as the retest
params.help: A return into the zone around the level with the close held beyond it, or a reversal at the level.
choice_labels: A return to the level with the close held beyond it

params.label: Retest zone
params.help: For a return to the level: how close to the level it must come, in average true ranges (0 means it must reach the level itself). The bar before must have stayed outside that zone.

params.label: Retest within (bars)
params.help: The return to the level must come within this many bars after the break, in the same session; a close back through the level first ends the idea.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: Just beyond the broken level by a buffer, or the extreme since the break.

params.label: Level buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken level': how many average true ranges beyond it.

params.label: The idea has ended
params.help: No exit signal from this template, or a close back through the previous day's high (or low) of that bar's own session.
choice_labels: A close back through the level

touch.long: low <= PDH() + $touch_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND low[1] > PDH() + $touch_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close > PDH()
touch.short: high >= PDL() - $touch_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND high[1] < PDL() - $touch_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close < PDL()
